Rule 4 (executive floor): executive floor items are granted by default. Exception: if entry is requested after 14:00, it is denied instead. Each loan is decided by the rule for its category. Within a rule, every exception clause is only considered if the clause immediately before it applied; when an exception applies, its decision replaces the previous one.

Rule 1 (theses): theses items are approved by default. Exception: if the borrower has overdue items, it is refused instead. But if, in addition, the loan is longer than 46 days, it is approved after all. Even then, if the item is at most 123 years old, it is refused. Further exception to the previous clause: if a digital copy is available, it is approved.
Rule 2 (maps): maps items are refused by default. Exception: if it is requested outside the exam period, it is approved instead. Further exception to the previous clause: if the borrower has overdue items, it is refused. But if, in addition, the borrower is a visiting scholar, it is approved after all. However, in that case, if unpaid fines are at most $23, it is refused.
Rule 3 (art prints): art prints items are refused by default. Exception: if no digital copy is available, it is approved instead. But if, in addition, the borrower is an undergraduate, it is refused after all. Even then, if the borrower has no overdue items, it is approved. But if, in addition, the loan is at most 28 days, it is refused after all.
Rule 4 (microfilm): microfilm items are approved by default. Exception: if the loan is longer than 15 days, it is refused instead. But if, in addition, the request is not signed by no one, it is approved after all. However, in that case, if the item is at most 204 years old, it is refused. However, in that case, if unpaid fines are at most $70, it is approved.

UNIVERSITY LIBRARY LOAN POLICY
Each loan is decided by the rule for its category. Within a rule, every exception clause is only considered if the clause immediately before it applied; when an exception applies, its decision replaces the previous one.

Rule 1 (audio recordings): audio recordings items are approved by default. Exception: if the borrower has overdue items, it is refused instead. Even then, if a digital copy is available, it is approved. However, in that case, if the request is signed by an academic advisor, it is refused. Even then, if the loan is at most 50 days, it is approved. But if, in addition, the item is at most 69 years old, it is refused after all.
Rule 2 (microfilm): microfilm items are approved by default. Exception: if the borrower is a faculty member, it is refused instead. Further exception to the previous clause: if the item is at most 127 years old, it is approved. But if, in addition, the request is not signed by no one, it is refused after all. But if, in addition, the borrower has overdue items, it is approved after all. However, in that case, if unpaid fines exceed $79, it is refused.
Rule 3 (art prints): art prints items are refused by default. Exception: if the request is signed by no one, it is approved instead. Further exception to the previous clause: if no digital copy is available, it is refused. But if, in addition, the borrower is not a faculty member, it is approved after all. However, in that case, if unpaid fines are at most $79, it is refused. Further exception to the previous clause: if it is requested during the exam period, it is approved.
Rule 4 (periodicals): periodicals items are refused by default. Exception: if the loan is at most 19 days, it is approved instead. Even then, if the request is signed by a librarian, it is refused. Further exception to the previous clause: if the borrower has overdue items, it is approved. Further exception to the previous clause: if unpaid fines are at most $59, it is refused. However, in that case, if the item is at most 87 years old, it is approved.
Rule 5 (theses): theses items are approved by default. Exception: if no digital copy is available, it is refused instead. Further exception to the previous clause: if unpaid fines are at most $18, it is approved. Even then, if it is requested outside the exam period, it is refused. Even then, if the loan is longer than 51 days, it is approved. But if, in addition, the item is at most 95 years old, it is refused after all.

- Loan 4 (category: art prints) - unpaid fines: $90; digital copy available: no; request signed by: no one; requested during exam period: yes; has overdue items: no; borrower: a faculty member; requested loan length: 48 days.
